DEMO WELFARE SCHEME
Operational Guidelines, 2024
Department of Demonstration Affairs

1. INTRODUCTION

1.1 The Demo Welfare Scheme provides income support to eligible small
farmer families across the country.

2. ELIGIBILITY

2.1 All landholding farmers' families, which have cultivable landholding
in their names, shall be eligible to receive benefit under the scheme.

2.2 The applicant shall have attained the age of eighteen years as on the
first day of the financial year in which the application is made.

3. BENEFITS

3.1 The benefit of Rs. 6000 per year shall be transferred in three equal
instalments of Rs. 2000 each, directly to the bank account of the
beneficiary.

4. EXCLUSIONS

4.1 All Institutional Land holders and farmer families in which one or
more of its members paid Income Tax in last assessment year are excluded
from the benefit under the scheme.

4.2 Serving or retired officers and employees of Central or State
Government Ministries, Offices and Departments are excluded from the
benefit under the scheme.

5. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED

5.1 The applicant shall furnish proof of landholding, a valid identity
document, and bank account details at the time of registration.
